review_scope: Human foot emission now owns spatial audio components so per-voice gain and a 3000 Hz low-pass can update current and future voices. Default gain remains one and the filter is bypassed. Play retains replay suppression, console scale, bank draw, attenuation and pitch; hoof emissions retain the original helper. Contact, landing, material and shuffle bodies below remain byte-identical. Offline auditions represent the default unfiltered profile only; no new hardware listening, native compilation or bit-identical hardware output is claimed.
